column1: # Session misses 26/08/2026 — module 03 rungs 0–1. Rewritten to cloze same day per CARD-RULES.md.
Python: "2" + 2 → {{c1::TypeError}} — + adds or glues, it never {{c2::mixes number and text}}.
A function where no return statement runs gives back {{c1::None}} — print-instead-of-return is the classic cause.
return {{c1::hands a value back — usable, testable}}; print {{c2::paints pixels and returns None}}.
String contains at least one digit: {{c1::any(ch.isdigit() for ch in pw)}} — pw.isdigit() asks {{c2::is the WHOLE string digits?}}.
any(...) takes {{c1::a stream of booleans}}, gives back {{c2::True if at least one is True}}.
An if/elif chain runs {{c1::the FIRST true branch, top to bottom}} — the rest skipped even if also true.
Python: 2 + 2.5 → {{c1::4.5, a float}} — numbers mix freely; only {{c2::number-meets-TEXT}} errors.
Fix is right but the checker still fails — first check: {{c1::is the file SAVED? (VS Code: ● on the tab)}}.
